thread:
mike_s: Heads-up — enterprise trial customer (acct acct-9876) reporting that their promo credit applied to the Private SKU instead of Dedicated. They hit a 402 / billing error when hitting the Dedicated endpoint after we provisioned reserved capacity. Customer is blocked from running workloads.

ellie_billing: can you paste the promo code and the project/tenant ID? I'll check audit logs and whether it's movable.

mike_s: Promo: REDWOOD_STARTER_2025, applied to tenant private-acct-9876-projectA. They expected it on dedicated-acct-9876-prod. Customer says they followed the onboarding link for Dedicated.

anjali_eng: curious — what error do they see on the API? 402 or 403? any sample request/response?

mike_s: they see 402 Payment Required with body: `{"error":"insufficient_credits","required_sku":"dedicated-small"}`. Repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/generate with header `x-account-id: acct-9876` 2) model: redwood-dedicated-small 3) get 402. I also grabbed the account view screenshot (on Slack thread with customer).

ellie_billing: ok. Pulling promo audit: REDWOOD_STARTER_2025 was initially redeemed against sku: private-enterprise (sku_id: sku-prv-001) at ts 1812345600 by onboarding flow. Looks like a mapping bug in the onboarding redirect. I can reassign but need approval for moving credits between SKUs for the same account.

sam_am: customer is on a trial with committed talks scheduled tomorrow — high priority. If we can reassign now it avoids escalation. Customer wants credits + ability to use Dedicated API immediately.

ellie_billing: plan: create a credit transfer from private-enterprise -> dedicated-small for acct-9876, amount 1000 credits, then validate their calls. I'll tag this BILL-4321. If transfer succeeds I'll also attach an audit note explaining why to avoid chargeback.

billing-bot: [automation] created ticket BILL-4321: credit-transfer requested by ellie_billing for acct-9876 (REDWOOD_STARTER_2025).

anjali_eng: while billing does the transfer, quick mitigation: you can point the customer to hosted fallback endpoint to unblock: `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted/generate` with same key — that'll use hosted credits instead of dedicated. Not ideal but works for immediate unblock.

mike_s: sent fallback option to customer, they prefer dedicated. They confirmed they can wait ~30m.

ellie_billing: update — audit shows promo redeemed with metadata tag `onboarding_flow=private` which we can clear and reassign. Performing transfer now.

billing-bot: [automation] transfer complete for BILL-4321. 1000 credits moved from sku-prv-001 to sku-ded-002 for acct-9876.

mike_s: Verified with customer — their API call now returns 200 and token usage is decrementing against Dedicated credits. Customer confirmed workloads running.

sam_am: great — can you add a short postmortem note to BILL-4321 describing the onboarding mapping bug? We need a small product fix to prevent future misapplies.

ellie_billing: will add notes and escalate to product. Also adding a short rollback playbook: 1) identify promo redemption sku 2) validate account mapping 3) perform credit transfer 4) confirm customer success.

anjali_eng: created issue in eng-onboarding: ONB-217 to add an explicit SKU selector on onboarding redirect. Assigning to @anjali_eng for triage.

mike_s: closing thread — customer unblocked, thanks all :tada:
